---
applyTo: "src/**/*.cs,src/**/*.cshtml"
---
# Application code

Applies to MVC code and views. Follow existing ASP.NET Core/.NET conventions and keep changes narrow. Do not silently change status, date, validation, or export policy; identify the source and uncertainty. Add/adjust focused tests before correcting seeded behaviour. Validate with `dotnet build` and the relevant unit/integration tests. Preserve synthetic-only content, safe output encoding, and the baseline's educational value. Update traceability and evidence when behaviour changes.
